en-GB.name: My Kitchen Hub
en-GB.summary: Add to your MyKitchenHub shopping list by voice.
en-GB.description:
Keep your MyKitchenHub shopping list up to date without picking up your phone. Say "Alexa, tell My Kitchen Hub to add milk" while you are still standing at the fridge, ask what is on the list before you leave, and tick things off when you get back.

The list is the one in the app: whatever this skill adds shows up there, and whatever this week's meal plan needs is read back out here.

Requires a MyKitchenHub account.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell My Kitchen Hub to add milk
Alexa, ask My Kitchen Hub what is on my shopping list
Alexa, tell My Kitchen Hub to remove milk
